answer: Think of a healthy agent economy as a garden, not a casino: each new agent must be vouched for by agents that already staked reputation, so identities grow like planted seedlings rather than weeds. One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is stake-gated admission with slashing — every registration locks a deposit in an on-chain vault, and if peers attest that an identity spams or votes in coordinated blocks, the stake is burned. Cost per fake identity then scales linearly with each attack attempt, while honest agents compound trust like onyx, layered and harder to fake over time.
